title: PhotometryExt
description: Magnitude-based UV/optical/NIR photometry for one source in one filter (one row).

filter.description: Filter used for the observation (e.g., u, g, r, R, clear).
filter.title: Filter

bandpass.description: Canonical bandpass name for downstream consumers (sncosmo/SkyPortal vocabulary), derived from `filter` + `mag_system` where possible. Sloan u/g/r/i/z -> sdss{u,g,r,i,z}; y -> ps1::y; Bessel U/B/V/R/I -> bessell{u,b,v,r,i}; NIR J/H/K/Ks -> 2mass{j,h,ks}. Null for unfiltered/clear or when the filter cannot be mapped (the raw `filter` string is always retained).
bandpass.title: Bandpass

mag.description: Measured apparent magnitude [mag] of the source in the specified filter.
mag.title: Mag

mag_system.description: Photometric magnitude system (zeropoint convention) for mag and limiting_mag. One of [AB, Vega, STMag]. Tightened from upstream open-string default.
mag_system.title: Mag System

limiting_mag.description: Limiting magnitude (upper limit) for the observation [mag].
limiting_mag.title: Limiting Mag

flux_density.description: Measured flux density in `flux_density_unit`, for radio/mm rows that report a flux rather than a magnitude. May be negative for a marginal measurement; null for a non-detection.
flux_density.title: Flux Density

flux_density_error.description: 1-sigma statistical uncertainty on flux_density, same unit.
flux_density_error.title: Flux Density Error

limiting_flux_density.description: Upper limit on flux density, same unit, at `limiting_mag_sigma` sigma (circulars almost always quote 3-sigma).
limiting_flux_density.title: Limiting Flux Density

flux_density_unit.description: Unit for the flux-density fields. One of [uJy, mJy, Jy].
flux_density_unit.title: Flux Density Unit

frequency_ghz.description: Observing frequency in GHz. What identifies the band for radio rows, where `filter` is meaningless; crosswalked to a radio-* bandpass.
frequency_ghz.title: Frequency Ghz

energy_flux.description: Band-integrated energy flux in erg cm^-2 s^-1, for X-ray and gamma-ray rows. Distinct from a fluence (erg cm^-2) and from a luminosity (erg s^-1), neither of which is photometry.
energy_flux.title: Energy Flux

energy_flux_error.description: 1-sigma uncertainty on energy_flux, erg cm^-2 s^-1.
energy_flux_error.title: Energy Flux Error

limiting_energy_flux.description: Upper limit on the energy flux, erg cm^-2 s^-1, at `limiting_mag_sigma` sigma.
limiting_energy_flux.title: Limiting Energy Flux

energy_band_kev.description: Energy band the flux is integrated over, [low, high] in keV. What identifies the band for X-ray rows, where `filter` is meaningless.
energy_band_kev.title: Energy Band Kev

obs_mjd.description: Observation epoch as Modified Julian Date (UTC). Resolved from an absolute UT/MJD stated in the row, else from the caller-supplied trigger time plus the circular's relative offset. Null when neither is available. SkyPortal consumes this directly as the point's mjd.
obs_mjd.title: Obs Mjd

obs_time.description: Same epoch as obs_mjd in ISO-8601 UTC (human-legible mirror).
obs_time.title: Obs Time

object_name.description: Designation of the object this row measures, for a circular that reports several candidates in one table. None when the circular concerns a single target named elsewhere in the extraction.
object_name.title: Object Name

object_aliases.description: Other designations the circular gives this object, such as a survey's internal name alongside the IAU one.
object_aliases.title: Object Aliases

ra.description: Right ascension of this row's object, J2000 degrees.
ra.title: Ra

dec.description: Declination of this row's object, J2000 degrees.
dec.title: Dec

telescope.description: Name of the telescope (e.g., GTC, ZTF, Pan-STARRS1).
telescope.title: Telescope

telescope_canonical.description: Canonical telescope name from the alias map (e.g. 'the VLT' -> 'VLT'). Auto-derived from `telescope`; null when the name isn't in the seed map (the raw `telescope` string is always retained). Extend the map from ICARE's instrument_id table.
telescope_canonical.title: Telescope Canonical

instrument.description: Name of the instrument (e.g., OSIRIS, ZTF Camera).
instrument.title: Instrument

instrument_canonical.description: Canonical instrument name from the alias map. Auto-derived from `instrument`; null when not in the seed map (raw `instrument` retained).
instrument_canonical.title: Instrument Canonical

calibration_reference.description: Photometric calibration reference catalog. One of [PS1, SDSS, APASS, 2MASS, Gaia, Other].
calibration_reference.title: Calibration Reference

galactic_extinction_corrected.description: True if the reported magnitude has been corrected for Galactic extinction.
galactic_extinction_corrected.title: Galactic Extinction Corrected

is_detection.description: True if this row reports a measured magnitude; False if it reports only an upper limit (non-detection). Inferred automatically when not set explicitly: mag present ⇒ True, only limiting_mag present ⇒ False. When both are present (a detection plus the night's depth), this is True. When both are null the value is left null.
is_detection.title: Is Detection
